result.conclusion: Confirmed D2430+D2431 at matched high doses (approximately 10.0 uM D2430 and 1.0 uM D2431 final). The combination exceeds the 0.50 threshold and improves inhibition over both matched-dose singles; P1 screening also showed 0.828 combination inhibition at this dose.

result.conclusion: Confirmed D2430+D2431 at approximately 0.752 uM each after 72 h in PC-14. P2 screening selected this dose corner; independent P3 controls gave mean inhibition 0.803 for the combination (SD 0.069), 0.028 for matched D2430 (SD 0.024), and 0.789 for matched D2431 (SD 0.072), for an HSA benefit of about 0.014. Three wells per group were measured, with P3-local blank and vehicle normalization. This is a calibrated virtual-assay result, not wet-lab validation.
